title: ButtslugServers
description: a modpack for my server and anyone who would want a slightly tweaked, vanilla experience! this mostly revamps visuals, terrain generation, and sound!
body: This modpack utilizes proximity voicechat combined with Sound Physics Remastered by henkelmax, falling leaves, vertical slabs, and a handful more of cosmetic mods combined with a minimap and terrain generation for a fun, immersive experience with your friends! This pack is vanilla with a little thrown in to make the game prettier and easier for a more relaxed experience.
